notes_zh: 一键配置环境升级：ffmpeg 现由软件自动安装（macOS 走 brew、Windows 走 winget），检测面板出现 ❌ 时直接点「一键配置环境」即可自动修复，无需手动复制命令；配置流程幂等，可反复执行。
notes_en: One-click setup upgraded: ffmpeg is now installed automatically by the software (brew on macOS, winget on Windows); when the environment panel shows ❌, just click “One-click setup” and everything is fixed automatically — no manual commands. The setup flow is idempotent and safe to re-run.
